from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u037/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color not in (2, 8) or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            if len(cells) >= 4:
                r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
                c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
                for y in range(r0,r1+1):
                    for x in range(c0,c1+1):
                        out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
